I can do that — before I make the change and send updates to attendees I need a few quick confirmations so I do exactly what you want.

Proposed default plan (I can change any item):
- Event: keep title "Design Review"
- Date: this coming Friday (or specify a date if you mean a later Friday)
- Time: 3:00–4:00 PM (sensible afternoon slot). Alternatives: 2:30–3:30 PM or 4:00–5:00 PM.
- Duration: keep current duration (confirm if you want it changed)
- Attendees: keep the same invite list (confirm if you want to add/remove people)
- Conferencing: add a video link if none exists (yes/no)
- Notifications: send update to all attendees (yes/no)
- Time zone: use your calendar default (tell me if you want a specific zone)

Which Friday do you mean (this coming Friday or a specific date)? Do you want the proposed 3:00–4:00 PM slot and the other defaults above? If yes, I’ll proceed and update the calendar and send notifications.
